name: norm
description: Build, migrate, validate, and test Bland v2 agents from your coding agent. Works directly with raw JSON (v1 pathway exports in, agent version snapshots out) — no scaffolding. Includes the full hand-migration doctrine (/norm:migrate), a mechanical snapshot audit (/norm:validate), and the simulation + test-chat verification loop (/norm:simulate). v2-only: no v1 authoring doctrine; v1 concepts appear solely as migration inputs.

bland_api_key.title: Bland API key
bland_api_key.description: Your Bland API key from app.bland.ai/settings/api-keys. Must belong to the org that OWNS the agent (snippets, tools, KBs, and secrets resolve only there). Masked on entry and stored encrypted in the OS keychain.

bland_api_url.title: Bland API URL (optional)
bland_api_url.description: Optional. Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai); only set this to point at a dev/staging server. Not a secret.
